recipes.notes: Allow Ice Cream to melt. This is a spoilage transformation, not a stove recipe.

Borborygmus.description: A second trigger while active causes sickness.

Desire of the Flesh.description: Reduces incoming damage by 15%, but attracts the Leyak more frequently.

Fog Caller.description: 50% chance of summoning a Fog Phenomenon weather event

Gourd Body.description: Reduces incoming damage by 25%; reduces movement speed (the reference lists −10, without an explicit unit).

Healthy-Ish Bite.description: Rapid healing, up to 180 health over the effect.

Heightened Senses.description: +10% Blunt Melee and Sharp Melee XP gain

Restoring Bite.description: Rapid healing, up to 120 health over the effect.

Royal Presence.description: +10% damage bonus for the player and grants Royal Inspiration to nearby allies

Royal Radiance.description: +1 cold resistance for the player and grants Royal Basking to nearby allies

Sedentary Lifestyle.description: +10% Agriculture, Construction, Cooking, and Crafting XP gain

Sick.description: Vomiting drains hunger and thirst. Clears after two vomiting episodes.

Souper Satisfied.description: Hunger and thirst drain 20% more slowly.

Stinky.description: Makes enemies more alert to your presence.

Sugar High.description: Stamina drains 25% more slowly; fatigue drains 10% faster and continence drains 25% faster.

Sweet Tooth.description: Snacks and soda restore 25% more hunger and thirst; sweets restore 50% more.

Temptation of the Flesh.description: Reduces incoming damage by 5%, but attracts the Leyak more frequently.

Too Hot to Handle.description: Emit a burst of fire when attacked
